identity.description: Firecrawl is the context API for AI agents: web scrape, crawl, map, search, and extract, returning clean Markdown or structured data. Official GitHub org is firecrawl.
identity.identity_notes: Docs, GitHub repo, and pricing page all describe the same product (firecrawl.dev). Confirmed as the web data API, not an unrelated 'Firecrawl'.

auth.scopes_notes: No scopes described in fetched sources. Keys are sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header (fc- prefix). Keyless access exists only for /v1/scrape and /v1/search on the free tier, with limits.

access.production_restrictions: Not established. Enterprise tier is 'Custom' and requires contacting sales for SLA, SSO, and bulk discounts, but the base free and paid tiers do not.

read_ops: search the web and fetch page content
extract structured data with natural language
api.rate_limits: Returns HTTP 429 when plan rate or concurrency limits are exceeded. Per-plan numbers are on a separate page that was not fetched.
api.limitations: Mostly web-read oriented; no account-data write resources established. Specific per-plan limits unknown. Base URL https://api.firecrawl.dev; v2 endpoints observed in examples (e.g. /v2/crawl).

open_questions: Whether the free plan issues an API key without a credit card or sales step is implied (no card required) but not explicitly stated for key issuance.
Whether there is a sandbox or trial separate from the free credit tier is unknown.
Whether the MCP hosted endpoint /v2/mcp-oauth implies OAuth2 for MCP clients is unverified; the docs page with the MCP setup returned 404 on fetch.
Webhook signature header and verification method not confirmed from official docs (third-party sources mention X-Firecrawl-Signature; unverified).
Per-plan rate limits are on a separate page not fetched.
Current Node SDK package name (@mendable/firecrawl-js in old results) not confirmed against official docs.
Community MCP repo owners and maintenance status not verified by fetch.
